Alif Laam Raa, Ekitabo kino Ebigambo bya kyo byasengekebwa oluvannyuma ne binnyonnyolwa mu bujjuvu okuva ewa Allah akola buli kintu nga asinziira ku nsonga nga ate amanyi mu bujjuvu buli kintu.
Kitegeeza abantu nti temusinzanga kintu kyonna wabula Allah Yekka mazima nze gye muli ndi mutiisa (ku Bibonerezo Bye) era omusanyusa (olw'Empeera Ye eri abalongoosa).

(Era kibagamba) nti mwegayirire Mukama Omulabirizi Wammwe era mumwenenyeze olwo nno ajja kubeeyagaza olweyagaza olulungi okutuusa ku kiseera ekigere era buli oyo yenna ateekeddwa okufuna obulungi agenda kumuwa obulungi bwe, naye bwe muva ku ekyo mazima nze mbatiirira ebibonerezo by'olunaku oluzibu.
Eri Allah y'eri obuddo bwammwe ate Yye nga bulijjo Muyinza ku buli kintu.

Abange, mazima bo (abatakkiriza) bakweka ebifuba byabwe babe nga beekweka Allah, abange (mukimanye nti) ne mu kiseera we beebikkira engoye zaabwe Allah amanya ebyo bye bakweka ne bye boolesa, anti mazima Yye amanyidde ddala ebiri mu bifuba.
Tewali kitonde kitambula ku nsi okuggyako nga okugabirirwa kwa kyo kuli ku Allah, era amanyi byonna ebikikwatako mu bulamu bw'ensi n’obwoluvannyuma, buli kimu kiri mu kitabo ekyeyolefu.

Era Yye y'Oyo, eyatonda eggulu omusanvu n'ensi mu nnaku mukaaga, era Arishi Ye yali ku mazzi, olwo nno alyoke abagezese ani mu mmwe asinga okukola obulungi, singa ogamba (Ggwe Muhammadi) nti mazima mmwe mujja kuzuukizibwa oluvannyuma lw'okufa abo abaakaafuwala bajja kugambira ddala nti kino (Kulaani) si kirala okuggyako eddogo ery'olwatu.

Singa tulindiriza ebibonerezo ku bo okutuuka ekiseera ekigere bajja kugambira ddala nti ate kiki ekibigaana okujja? Abange, Olunaku lwe biribajjira si bya kubaggyibwako, era ebyo bye baajeejanga biribeetoloola.
Omuntu bwe tumukombesa ku kusaasira okuva Gyetuli ate oluvannyuma ne tukumuggyako mazima yye akutuka n'okusuubira n'akaafuwala.
Naye ate bwe tumukombesa ku byengera oluvannyuma lw'ebizibu ebiba bimutuuseeko ajja kugambira ddala nti obuzito bunvuddeko, mazima yye aba musanyufu eyeeraga.
Okuggyako abo abagumiikiriza ne bakola emirimu emirongoofu balina ekisonyiwo n'empeera ennene.

Olabika nga oli waakuleka ebimu ebissibwa gy'oli, era ekyo nga kikunyiga mu kifuba kyo olw'okuba nti bagamba nti: Singa aweebwa eggwanika oba Malayika n'ajja naye. Mazima ggwe oli mutiisa. Ate nga Allah Ye Mweyimirize ku buli kintu.

Oba bagamba nti (Kulaani eno Muhammadi) yagigunjaawo, bagambe nti: Kale muleeteeyo essuula kkumi enjiiye ezigifaanana (Kulaani) era ng'oggyeko Allah muyite yenna gwe musobodde (abayambeko) bwe muba nga mwogera mazima.
Bwe bataabaanukule, olwo nno mumanye nti mazima yyo (Kulaani) yassibwa na kumanya kwa Allah era tewali kisinzibwa mu butuufu okuggyako Yye, abaffe mmwe mwewaddeyo ewa Allah (ne musiramuka)?
Oyo yenna ayagala obulamu obw'ensi n'ebyokwewunda byayo tubasasula mu bujjuvu emirimu gyabwe mu yo era nga bo mu yo tebaseerwa.
Abo beebo abatalina ku Nkomerero kintu kyonna okuggyako Omuliro, era byonna bye baakola ku nsi ne bitabalibwa, bye baakolanga byalinga byonoonefu.

Abaffe (balimbisa Muhammadi) oyo ali ku bunnyonnyofu obuva ewali Mukama Omulabirizi We, era nga abusoma Mujulizi (Jibuliiru) ava ewa Allah nga n'olubereberye lwe waliwo Ekitabo kya Musa nga kiraga ekkubo era nga kusaasira, abo (Muhammad n'abantu be) bagikkiriza ate ebibiina byonna ebitagikkiriza Omuliro y'endagaano yaabwe, tobeeranga mu kugibuusabuusaamu, mazima yyo ge mazima agavudde ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Wo. Naye ddala abantu abasinga obungi tebakkiriza.

Ani mulyazamaanyi okusinga oyo agunja obulimba ku Allah! abo bagenda kwanjulwa ewa Mukama omulabirizi waabwe nti abo baawaayiriza Mukama Katonda Omulabirizi waabwe. Abange ekibonerezo kya Allah kibeere ku balyazamaanyi.
Abo abaziyiza abantu ku Kkubo lya Allah ne babaagaliza kukoleramu bikyamu, era nga nabo Olunaku lw'Enkomerero baluwakanya.

Abo tebaali ba kulemera ku nsi, era ng'oggyeko Allah tebalinaayo ba mukwano balala bayinza kubawonya, ebibonerezo byabwe bigenda kwongezebwamu anti baali tebasobola kuwulira era nga bwe baali tebalaba.
Abo be baafiiriza emyoyo gyabwe bye baayiiyanga ne bibaggwaako.
Kikakafu ddala bo ku Lunaku lw'Enkomerero be balifaafaganirwa ennyo.
Mazima abo Abakkiriza ne bakola emirimu emirongoofu ne bamenyekera Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe abo be bannannyini Jjana, bo mu yo baakutuulamu bugenderevu.
Ekifaananyi ky'ebibinja ebibiri (ebyogeddwako waggulu) kiringa ekya muzibe ne kiggala n'oyo alaba era nga awulira abaffe balabika nti bafaanana temwebuulirira!.
Mazima twatuma Nuuhu eri abantu be (n'abagamba) nti: Mazima nze ndi mutiisa wammwe omweyolefu.
(Mbategeeza) nti Temusinza kintu kyonna okuggyako Allah mazima nze mbatiiriddeko ebibonerezo by'olunaku olw'okuluma obujiji.

Abakungu abo abaakaafuwala mu bantu be ne bagamba nti: Tetukulaba ggwe okuggyako okuba nti oli muntu nga ffe, era tetulaba bakugoberedde okuggyako abaawansi mu ffe ab'endowooza entono, mwenna tetubalabamu nkizo yonna ku ffe wabula tubalowooza kuba balimba.

Nuuhu n'agamba nti abange bantu bange mulaba mutya singa mba ndi ku bunnyonnyofu obuva ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Wange era n'ampa okusaasira okuva Gy;ali naye mmwe ekyo ne mutakiraba, abaffe tusobola okukibawaliriza nga ate mmwe temukyagala.

Era abange mmwe abantu bange (kye mbagamba) si kibasabirako sente, empeera yange teri wantu wonna okuggyako ewa Allah (era nnyaniriza abo bonna ababa bangoberedde) era siri nze waakugoba abo Abakkiriza (ne bwe bataba ba bitiibwa) mazima ddala bo baakusisinkana Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe naye mazima ddala nze mbabala mmwe nga muli bantu abatamanyi.
Era abange bantu bange ani ayinza okuntaasa ku Allah bwe mba mbagobye, abaffe temulowooza?

Era siyinza kubagamba (mmwe) nti nnina amawanika ga Allah, era simanyi byekusifu, sigamba nti mazima nze ndi Malayika era sigamba abo amaaso ga mmwe begatawa kitiibwa nti Allah tagenda kubawa birungi, Allah y'amanyidde ddala ebyo ebiri mu mitima gyabwe, n'olwekyo mazima nze ne mmala nkikola ddala mbeera mu beeyisa obubi.
Ne bagamba nti: Owange Nuuhu, mazima otukaayanyizza n'oyitiriza okutukaayanya, kale tutuuseeko ebyo by'otulagaanyisa bw'oba nga oyogera mazima.
(Nuuhu) n'agamba nti mazima Allah ajja kubibatuusaako bw'anaaba ayagadde, ate temuyinza kumulemesa.
Era okubuulirira kwange tekujja kubagasa singa mba njagadde okubabuulirira, ate Allah n'aba nga ayagadde kubabuza. Yye Ye Mukama Omulabirizi Wammwe era Gy'ali gye mulizzibwa.
Oba bagamba nti (Muhammadi, Kulaani) yagunja ŋŋunje, bagambe nti: Bwe mba nnagyegunjirawo, ekyonoono ekyo kiri ku nze, naye nange sirina kakwate ku ebyo bye mwonoona.
Nuuhu n'aweebwa Obubaka nti mazima tebagenda kukkiriza mu bantu bo okuggyako abo abakkiriza edda n'olwekyo tonakuwala olw'ebyo bye baali bakola.
Kale kola eryato nga Naffe tukutunuulidde era okole okusinziira ku ndagirira Yaffe era toyogera nange ku bikwata ku abo abeeyisa obubi, mazima ddala bo baakufiira mu mazzi.
(Nuuhu) n'aba nga akola eryato. Buli lwonna abakungu mu bantu be lwe baamuyitirangako baamusekereranga n'agamba nti bwe muba nga mutusekerera naffe tujja kubasekerera nga bwe mutusekerera.
Lumu mujja kumanya ani gwe binajjira ebibonerezo ebimuswaza era n'ajjirwa ebibonerezo eby'olubeerera.

(Baabeera bwe batyo) okutuusa Ekiragiro kyaffe lwe kyajja ettannuulu n'efukumuka amazzi ne tugamba (Nuuhu) nti pakira mu lyo, ng'ojja mu buli mutindo gwa biramu bibiri bibiri, ekisajja n'ekikazi, era pakiramu abantu b'o mu maka go okuggyako oyo eyakakatako edda ekigambo (ekyokuzikirira) era pakiramu buli yenna eyakkiriza, wabula tewaali bakkiriza baali naye okuggyako batono.
(Nuuhu) n'agamba nti mulinnye eryato, okutambula kwa lyo n'okuyimirira kwa lyo byonna bibeewo ku lw'Erinnya lya Allah, mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wange Musonyiyi Musaasizi.

Na lyo ne liseeyeeya nabo, mu mayengo agenkana ensozi, mu kiseera ekyo Nuuhu yakowoola mutabani we eyali awo ku mabbali g'eryato n'amugamba nti mwana wange linnya ogende naffe tosigala n'abakafiiri (n'ozikirira).

(Omwana) n'agamba nti: Nja kulinnya olusozi lujja kumponya amazzi. (Nuuhu) n'agamba nti: Tewali ayinza kuwonya olwaleero (muntu n'asimattuka ) ku Kiragiro kya Allah, okuggyako Allah gw'anaaba asaasidde. Awo nno amayengo gaayawula wakati waabwe (omwana) n'abeera mu baasaanawo.

(Ng'ebitonde bimaze okuzikirira) waalangirirwa nti: Owange ttaka mira amazzi naawe ggulu lekera awo okutonnyesa enkuba era amazzi gaakalira ensonga n'ekoma awo eryato ne litereera ku lusozi oluyitibwa Juudi era ne walangirirwa nti: Okwesamba okusaasira kwa Allah kubeere ku bantu abeeyisa obubi.

Nuhu n'akoowoola Mukama omulabiriziwe naagamba nti Mukama omulabirizi wange mazima Mutabani wange y'omu ku bo mu maka gange era mazima endagaano yo ya mazima era ggwe osinga abalala bonna okugoba e nsonga.

(Allah) n'agamba nti: Owange Nuuhu, mazima yye si wa mu bantu bo mazima yye yakola ekikolwa ekitali kirungi, n'olwekyo tonsaba ekyo ky'otalinaako kumanya, mazima nze nkubuulirira oleme kubeera mu batategeera.
(Nuuhu) n'agamba nti nkusaba obukuumi bwo nneme kuba nga nkusaba ekyo kye sirinaako kumanya era bw'otonsonyiwe n'onsaasira nja kubeera mu bafaafaaganiddwa.

Newalangirirwa nti: Owange Nuuhu, kka ove mu lyato, emirembe n'emikisa ebiva Gyetuli bibeere ku ggwe, ne ku bibiina by'abantu ebiri naawe ne ku bibiina by'abantu be tujja okweyagaza mu nsi, oluvannyuma ebibonerezo ebiruma ennyo bibatuukeko okuva Gyetuli.
Ebyo bye bimu ku bintu ebyekusifu tubikutumira ggwe (Muhammadi) tobimanyangako ggwe wadde abantu bo olubereberye lwa kino, n'olwekyo gumiikiriza, mazima enkomerero (ennungi) y’abatya Allah.

Era ab'ekika kya 'Aadi twabatumira muganda waabwe Huudu n'agamba nti: Abange abantu bange, musinze Allah, ng'oggyeko Yye temulinaayo kirala kyonna kisinzibwa mu butuufu, temuli mmwe okuggyako abagunja obugunja bye musinza.
Abange bantu bange, sibasaba mpeera ku kino, empeera yange teri okugyako ku Oyo eyantonda, abaffe temutegeera?!

Era abange bantu bange, mwegayirire Mukama Omulabirizi Wammwe Allah, oluvannyuma mwenenye mudde Gy'ali, ajja kubasindikira okuva mu bire waggulu enkuba etonnya ngeddiŋŋana, era abongere amaanyi ku maanyi gammwe, era temukyukanga ne muva ku ekyo ne muba aboonoonyi.
Ne bagamba nti: Owange ggwe Huudu, totuleetedde bujulizi bweyolefu (ku ebyo by'ogamba) ate era naffe tetuyinza kuleka bisinzibwa byaffe olw'okuba ogambye, era ffe tetugenda kukukkiriza.

(Okusinziira ku ebyo by'oyogera) tetulina kye tugamba okuggyako nti abamu ku bakatonda baffe be baakulalusa. (Huudu) n'agamba nti: Era mazima nze njuliza Allah nammwe mujulire nti ddala nze ndi wala n'ebyo bye mugatta ku Allah.
Ne mulekawo Allah, kale munsalire enkwe mwenna ate temunnindiriza.

Mazima nze nneekutte ku Mukama Katonda Omulabirizi Wange era Mukama Omulabirizi Wammwe , tewali kitambula ku nsi okuggyako Yye, Yye y'akutte akawompo kakyo, mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wange ali ku kkubo eggolokofu.

Bwe munaava ku ekyo mazima nze mmaze okubatuusaako ekyo kye nnatumwa nakyo era Mukama Omulabirizi Wange mu kifo kya mmwe ajja kussaawo abantu abalala abatali mmwe, era temulina kabi ke mugenda kumutuusaako. Mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wange buli kyonna ekikolebwa akirondoola.
Ekiragiro Kyaffe bwe kyamala okujja ku lw'okusaasira Kwaffe, twawonya Huudu n'abo Abakkiriza abaali naye ne tubawonya Ebibonerezo ebizito.
Abantu abo ab'ekibiina kya 'Aadi baawakanya Ebigambo bya Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe ne bajeemera Ababaka Be ne bagoberera ekigambo kya buli eyeekuza awalaaza empaka.

Mu nsi muno ne bagoberezebwako ekikolimo, mu ngeri y'emu ne ku Lunaku lw'Enkomerero, abange mazima ab'ekika kya 'Aadi baajeemera Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe, abange okubula okwewala ennyo kutuuke ku b'ekika kya 'Aadi abantu ba Huudu.

Bo ab'ekika kya Thamuudu twabatumira muganda waabwe Swalehe, n'agamba nti: Abange bantu bange, musinze Allah temulinaayo kintu kyonna kigwanidde kusinzibwa okuggyako Yye, Yye Ye yabatandikawo nga abaggya mu nsi, ate n'abakwasa obuyinza okugikulaakulanya, kale mumwegayirire, era mwenenye, mudde Gy'ali mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wange ali kumpi ayanukula (abamusaba).

Ne bagamba nti: Owange Swalehe, mazima obadde mu ffe, nga tukulinamu essuubi, nga kino tekinnabaawo. Otugaana okusinza ebyo bakadde baffe bye basinza era mazima ffe tulina okubuusabuusa okujjudde okutankana ku ekyo ky'otuyitira okujja gye kiri.

N'agamba nti: Abange bantu bange, mukiraba nti singa mba ndi ku bunnyonnyofu obuva ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Wange, era ne nfuna okusaasira okuva Gy'ali, kale ani anantaasa ku Allah bwe mmujeemera (singa nkolera ku bya mmwe), temulina kye munnyongera okuggyako okufiirizibwa.

Abange bantu bange eno eŋŋamiya evudde wa Allah nga kabonero gye muli (okukakasa Obwannabbi bwange), n'olwekyo mugireke erye ebiri mu nsi ya Allah, temugezaako ne mugituusaako akabi konna ne. kibaviirako okutuukibwako ebibonerezo eby'amangu.
(Ne bamuwakanya era) ne bagifumita olwo nno ye (Swalehe) kwe kubagamba nti: Mweyagalire mu mayumba gammwe okumala ennaku ssatu (zokka), eyo ndagaano etalimbisibwa.

Ekiragiro Kyaffe bwe kyamala okujja, twawonya Swalehe n'abo abakkiriza abaali naye olw'okusaasira okuva Gyetuli era ne tubawonya ne mu buswavu obw'olunaku olwo, anti mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wo Ye Waamaanyi Nnantakubwakumukono.
Abo nno abeeyisa obubi ne batuukibwako olubwatuka (olw'amaanyi) olwo nno ne bakeesa nga mirambo egigaŋŋalamye mu mayumba gaabwe.

(Engeri gye baazikirizibwamu) baali nga abatawangaalirangako mu go, abange mazima abantu b'ekika kya Thamuudu baawakanya Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe, abange abantu ba Thamuudu babeere wala nnyo n'okusaasira kwa Allah.

Mazima Ababaka baffe (Bamalayika) bajja eri Ibraahiimu n'amawulire ag'essanyu, nti (Yye ne Mukyala we bajja kuzaala omwana Isihaaka) ne bamugamba nti: Mirembe, naye n'abagamba (ng’abaddamu) nti mirembe, waayitawo akaseera katono n'abaleetera ennyana enjokye.
(Ibraahiimu) bwe yalaba emikono gyabwe nga tegituuka ku nnyama n'abeekengera, (Bamalayika) bo kwe kumugamba nti: Totutya, mazima ffe tuli Bamalayika tutumiddwa eri abantu ba Luutu (okubazikiriza).

Nga mukyala wa Ibraahiimu (Saala) ayimiridde (abawulira) n'aseka (nga yeewuunya olw'ebyo bye yawulira) olwo nno ne tumuwa amawulire ag'essanyu ag'okuba nti ajja kuzaala Isihaaka ate nga n’oluvanyuma lwa Isihaaka wajja kuzaalibwayo Ya'kuubu (omuzzukulu).

(Omukyala Saala bwe yamala okufuna amawulire g’okuzaala Isihaaka) n'agamba (nga bwe yewuunya) nti: gano nga mawano nze (Saala) ŋŋenda kuzaala omwana nga ndi mukadde bwe nti nga n'ono baze kinvinvi, mazima kino kintu ekyewuunyisa ennyo.

(Bamalayika) ne bagamba nti: Butya bwe weewuunya Ekiragiro kya Allah! Okusaasira kwa Allah n'emikisa Gye bibeere ku mmwe abantu b'enju (ya Ibraahiimu). Mazima Allah atenderezebwa nnyo Waakitiibwa nnyo.
Ensisi bwe yamala okuggwa ku Ibraahiimu, nga amaze n'okufuna amawulire ag'essanyu, yagenda mu maaso nga atukaayanya (nga awolereza) abantu ba Luutu.
Mazima Ibraahiimu yali waakisa nnyo ate nga asaba nnyo Allah era nga amwenenyeza ku buli nsonga.
(Ba Malayika ne bamugamba nti) Ibraahiimu, tobawolereza mazima kimaze okutuuka Ekiragiro kya Mukama Omulabirizi Wo era mazima bo bagenda kujjirwa ebibonerezo ebitali bya kuzzibwayo.
Ababaka baffe bwe bajja ewa Luutu, tebaamusanyusa n'awulira bubi (olw'okuba yali tasobola kubakuuma) era n'agamba nti: Luno lunaku luzibu.

Abantu be ne bajja gy'ali nga banguwa naye nga okusooka baali bakola ebibi (Luutu) n'agamba nti abange bantu bange bawala bange baabo be balungi gyemuli, mutye Allah temunswaza eri abagenyi bange, abaffe mu mmwe temuli musajja muluŋŋamu!.
Ne bagamba nti: Mazima okimanyi nti bawala bo tetubalinaako bwetaavu, era mazima ddala ggwe omanyi kye twagala.
(Luutu) n'agamba nti (nneegomba) singa mbadde nnina amaanyi ku mmwe, oba empagi eŋŋumu gye nsobola okwesigamako, (abantu abasobola okuntaasa).

(Bamalayika) ne bagamba nti: Luutu, ffe tuli Babaka ba Mukama Omulabirizi Wo (abo) tebajja kukutuukako, tambula n'abantu bo mu kitundu ky'ekiro, era omu ku mmwe takyuka (n'atunula emabega, genda n'abantu bo) okuggyako mukyala wo, anti mazima kiri nti ajja kutuukwako ebinaatuuka ku bali. Mazima ekiseera ekibalagaanyisiddwa bwe budde bw'okumakya, obudde bw'oku makya tebuli kumpi!
(Ekitundu mwe baali babeera), Ekiragiro Kyaffe bwe kyajja, waggulu wa kyo wetwazza wansi era ne tukiwandagazaako amayinja amakole mu bbumba ejjokye nga gajjira kumukumu.
(Amayinja ago) nga malambe okuva ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Wo, ekibonerezo ng'ekyo tekiri wala ku buli abo bonna abeeyisa obubi.

Ate abe Madiyana twabatumira Muganda waabwe Swaibu naagamba nti abange bantu bange musinze Allah temulinaawo kirala kyonna kye mulina kusinza ekitali yye, temukendeezanga ebipimo ne minzani, mazima nze mbalaba nga musigala muli bulungi (bwe muba temukendeezezza mu bipimo ne minzani). Era mazima nze mbatiiriddeko ebibonerezo by'olunaku olugenda okwetooloola buli kimu.
Era abange bantu bange mutuukirize ebipimo ne minzaani mu bwesimbu, temukumpanyanga abantu ebintu byabwe, era temukolanga ebibi mu nsi nga mugenderera okwonoona.
Ebyo Allah bye yabalekedde (nga oggyeko by'ayogedde wa ggulu ebitaliimu kukumpanya bantu) bye birungi gye muli bwe muba nga muli Bakkiriza. Era nze siri kalondoozi ku mmwe.
Ne bagamba nti: Owange Shu'ayibu, okusaala kwo kwe kukulagira okuba nga tuleka bakadde baffe bye basinza, oba tukkirizibwa okukola mu mmaali yaffe bye twagala, anti ggwe oli alumirwa ow'amagezi.

N'agamba nti: Abange bantu bange, mulaba nti singa mbadde ku buluŋŋamu obwava ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Wange, n'ampa ne Riziki ennungi ate nnyinza okubaleka (ne ssibagambako) ate era ssaagala kubaawukanako ne nkola ebyo bye mbagaana sirina kye ŋŋenderera kyonna okuggyako okulongoosa nga bwe mba nsobodde, era okuluŋŋama kwange tekuli okuggyako ewa Allah Yye gwenneekutteko era Gy'ali gye ŋŋenda okudda.

Era abange bantu bange okunkolako obulabe kuleme kubaleetera kunnimbisa ne mutuukwako ebyo ebyatuuka ku bantu ba Nuuhu oba abantu ba Huudu oba abantu ba Swalehe era abantu ba Luutu tebali wala na mmwe.
Era musabe Mukama Omulabirizi Wammwe ekisonyiwo olwo nno mwenenye okudda Gy'ali mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wange Musaasizi Waamukwano nnyo (eri ebitonde Bye).
Ne bagamba nti: Owange Shu'ayibu, bingi mu by'ogamba tetubitegeera ate era tukulaba nga oli munafu muffe singa si kika kyo twandikukubye amayinja era ggwe tolina kitiibwa kyonna gye tuli.

N'agamba nti abange bantu bange ekika kyange kye ky'ekitiibwa gye muli okusinga Allah ne mutuuka okumussa emabega wammwe nga mumukubye amabega mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wange yeetoolodde byonna bye mukola.
Era abange bantu bange mukolere ku nkola yammwe nange ka nkole, ddala mujja kumanya ani, anajjirwa ebibonerezo ebimuswaza, era ani mulimba, naye era mulindirire, mazima nze nnindirira awamu na mmwe.

Ekiragiro Kyaffe bwe kyamala okujja, ku lw'okusaasira Kwaffe, twawonya Shu'ayibu wamu n'abo abakkiriza abaali naye. Abo abeeyisa obubi ne batuukwako okubwatuka ne bakeesa enkya nga mirambo egigaŋŋalamye mu mayumba gaabwe.
Ne baba nga abatagabeerangamu. Abange, abantu be Madiyana babeere wala nnyo n'okusaasira kwa Allah ng'abantu ba Thamuudu bwe beesamba okusaasira kwa Allah.
Era Mazima twatuma Musa ne ebyamagero Byaffe n’obusobozi bwokulambika ensonga.
Agende ewa Falaawo n'eri abakungu be, bo abakungu baagoberera ekigambo kya Falaawo, naye nga ekigambo kya Falaawo si kiruŋŋamu.
(Falaawo) alikulembera abantu be ku Lunaku lw'Enkomerero n'abayingiza Omuliro. nga buyingiro bubi bwe baliyingira.
Ate ne bagoberezebwa ekikolimo kuno ku nsi ne ku Lunaku lw'Enkomerero, ennyongeza mbi ne kye bongerako nakyo kibi.
Ebyo bye bimu ku bigambo ebikwata ku bitundu bye twazikiriza, tubikutegeeza ggwe (Muhammadi), mu byo mulimu ebikyaliwo nga n'ebirala byasaanawo.

(Okubatuusaako ebyo) tetwabayisa bubi wabula beeyisa bokka obubi, bakatonda baabwe abo be basaba ne bava ku Allah omu tebaabagasa kintu kyonna, Ekiragiro kya Mukama Omulabirizi Wo bwe kyajja, era tebaabongera okuggyako okufaafaaganirwa.
Bwe kutyo bwe kuba okukwata kwa Mukama Omulabirizi Wo. Bw'akwata ebitundu nga biri mu mbeera ey'okweyisa obubi mazima okukwata kwe kuluma nnyo era kuyitirivu.
Mazima ekyo mulimu ekyokulabirako eri oyo atya ebibonerezo by'Olunaku lw'Enkomerero, olwo lwe lunaku abantu bonna lwe balikuŋŋaanyirizibwako era olwo olunaku abantu bonna balirubeerako.
Era tetululindiriza okuggyako okutuuka ku kiseera kya lwo ekigere.
Olunaku bwe lulituuka teri muntu yenna agenda kwogera okuggyako lwa kukkiriza kwa Allah, nga mu bo mulibaamu aboonoonefu n'abalongoofu.
Bo abo abaajeema baakuyingira Omuliro baliba balina mu gwo okusinda n'okukema.
Baakugubeeramu ebbanga eggulu (omusanvu) n'ensi lye birimala nga weebiri okuggyako ekiseera Mukama Omulabirizi Wo ky'aliba ayagadde mazima Mukama Omulabirizi Wo akola ekyo ky'aba ayagadde.

Bo abo abaweebwa obulongoofu baakuyingira e jjana nga baakugibeeramu ebbanga eggulu omusanvu ne nsi bye birimala nga weebiri okugyako ebbanga Mukama Omulabirizi Wo ly'aliba ayagadde nga okwo kuweebwa okutalibaako kutaataaganyizibwa.
Tobaamu kubuusabuusa mu ebyo bye basinza, tebasinza okuggyako nga bajjajaabwe bwe baasinzanga olubereberye, era mazima Ffe tujja kubatuukiririza omugabo gwabwe awatali kukendezaako.

Mazima twawa Musa ekitabo ne kyawukanwamu, singa ssi kigambo ekyakulembera nga kiva ewa Mukama omulabirizi wo walisaliddwawo wakati waabwe mubwangu, era mazima nabo (abatakukkiriza ggwe Nnabbi Muhammadi) bali mu kubuusabuusa okujjudde okutankana mu yo (Kulaani).
Era mazima ddala bonna Mukama Omulabirizi Wo agenda kubasasula emirimu gyabwe mu bujjuvu, mazima Yye amanyidde ddala bye bakola.
Kale beera mwesimbu nga bwolagiddwa, n'abo abeenenyezza naawe era temubeera bakiwagi, anti mazima Yye (Allah) bye mukola abiraba.
Era temuggweranga ku abo abeeyisa obubi, Omuliro ne gubakwata ate nga oggyeko Allah temulinaayo bayambi balala, era temugenda kutaasibwa.
Era yimirizaawo esswala ku nsalosalo ebbiri ez'emisana (ku makya n'akawungezi) n'ekiseera ekisooka ku kiro mazima ebirungi biggyawo ebibi. Okwo nno kubuulirira eri abo abajjukira.
Era gumiikiriza, bulijjo Allah tayinza butasasula mpeera ya bakozi ba bulungi.

Singa waaliyo mu mirembe egyabakulembera abantu abalina kye baasigazaawo (mu ddiini) nga bagaana obwonoonefu mu nsi, (tebaaliyo) okuggyako batono nnyo mu abo be twawonya mu bo. Wabula bo abeeyisa obubi ne batwalibwa ebirungi bye baaweebwa mu nsi ne baba aboonoonyi.
Mukama omulabiriziwo tabangako azikiriza bitundu mu bulyazaamaanyi nga ate abantu baabyo bakozi ba bulungi.
Singa Mukama Omulabirizi Wo Allah yayagala, abantu bonna yandibafudde ekibiina kimu, naye tebagenda kuva ku kwawukana.

Okuggyako oyo Mukama omulabiriziwo gw'aba asaasidde. N'olwekyo kyeyava abatonda, era kyakakata ekigambo kya Mukama Omulabirizi Wo nti ŋŋenda kujjuza Omuliro Jahannama nga nzigya mu majinni n'abantu okutwalira awamu.
Era tukutegeeza buli kimu ekikwata ku Babaka, ekyo kye tunyweza nakyo omutima gwo, era mu kino ojjiddwa amazima n'okubuulirira, era nga kya kujjukiza eri Abakkiriza.
Era gamba abo abatakkiriza nti mukolere ku nkola ya mmwe naffe ka tukole.
Era mulindirire naffe tulindiridde.
Era bya Allah Yekka ebyama by’eggulu n’ensi, era ensonga zonna zidda Gy'ali, kale sinza Yye Yekka era wesige Yye Yekka. Era Mukama Katonda Omulezi Wo tagayaalirira bye mukola.
